rows.grounds: indeclinable expressing absence; governs the accompanying noun in sense
compound denoting thorough knowledge of the letters
compound indicating a vast number of preliminary ritual repetitions
interrogative pronoun questioning value or purpose

items.question: What value do vast preliminary rites hold without complete knowledge of the letters?
premises: Complete knowledge of the letters is required.
Preliminary rites may be performed in crores.
Ritual quantity does not replace requisite knowledge.
items.inference: Without complete knowledge of the letters, even a crore of preliminary rites has no value.
items.plain_english: Without complete knowledge of the letters, what is the use of a crore of preliminary rites?
